# Mobius v0.7.0 - Table of Contents

> Local metrics library

## Pages

- [Mobius](https://mobius.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://mobius.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Mobius](https://mobius.hexdocs.pm/Mobius.md): Localized metrics reporter

- [Mobius.Clock](https://mobius.hexdocs.pm/Mobius.Clock.md): Behaviour for Mobius to check if the clock is set
- [Mobius.Event](https://mobius.hexdocs.pm/Mobius.Event.md): An single event

- [Mobius.EventLog](https://mobius.hexdocs.pm/Mobius.EventLog.md): API for working with the event log

- [Mobius.Exports](https://mobius.hexdocs.pm/Mobius.Exports.md): Support retrieving historical data in different formats
- [Mobius.RRD](https://mobius.hexdocs.pm/Mobius.RRD.md): A round robin database for Mobius

- Exceptions
  - [Mobius.DataLoadError](https://mobius.hexdocs.pm/Mobius.DataLoadError.md): Used when there is problem loading data into the mobius storage

  - [Mobius.Exports.MBFParseError](https://mobius.hexdocs.pm/Mobius.Exports.MBFParseError.md): Use when there is an error parsing a Mobius Binary Format (MBF) binary

  - [Mobius.Exports.UnsupportedMetricError](https://mobius.hexdocs.pm/Mobius.Exports.UnsupportedMetricError.md): Error for trying to export metric types where there is no support in the
export implementation

  - [Mobius.FileError](https://mobius.hexdocs.pm/Mobius.FileError.md): Used when there is an error conducting file operations
